tickets.title: P3-31: in-flight order ledger for the copier reconciler
tickets.defect: Between Submit and Accepted an order is in neither Account.Orders nor the bracket cache, so a timer-driven reconciler (which does not exist yet) would create a second leg — reproducing the duplicate-leg family (P0-49, P0-55, P1-56, P0-59) through the very mechanism meant to cure it. The event-driven callers pass submitInFlight=false because the bracket's StopInFlight/TargetInFlight reservation already serialises them and the submitted leg is recorded in bracket.WorkingStop before a second pass can run. A background timer is what needs a real ledger. The Reconcile seam already accepts stopSubmitInFlight/targetSubmitInFlight booleans and suppresses Create only (never Cancel). The ledger itself does not exist.
tickets.spec:
Build an InFlightLedger class and a background timer in TradeCopierEngine.

1. InFlightLedger (new class in CopierReconciler.cs or a new file in addons/):
   - Constructor accepts timeoutSeconds (default 30).
   - Register(accountName, instrumentFullName, legName): records a pending submit with a timestamp. Thread-safe under a lock.
   - Settle(accountName, instrumentFullName, legName): removes the entry (order appeared in Account.Orders / Accepted).
   - Fail(accountName, instrumentFullName, legName): removes the entry (submit returned null / threw).
   - IsInFlight(accountName, instrumentFullName, legName) -> bool: true if a matching entry exists and has not expired.
   - PurgeExpired(): removes entries older than timeoutSeconds.
   - Count -> int: number of entries currently tracked.
   - The key is (accountName, instrumentFullName, legName) — all OrdinalIgnoreCase.

2. Background timer in TradeCopierEngine:
   - A System.Threading.Timer that fires every ~5 seconds, iterating active brackets and calling the reconciler (DecideLegActions) with submitInFlight fed from the ledger's IsInFlight.
   - The timer callback must NOT hold _lock across broker reads (P1-10/12). Read bracket state under _lock, release, do broker reads, call Reconcile, execute actions under _lock.
   - Call PurgeExpired() on each tick.
   - Start the timer in Start() (or State.Configure) and dispose it in Stop().

3. Wire existing event-driven callers (SyncFollowerStopOnce, SyncFollowerTargetOnce) to register/clear ledger entries:
   - Before Submit: ledger.Register(account, instrument, legName)
   - On submit success (order != null): the order will appear in Account.Orders and Settle will be called from OnFollowerOrderUpdate, OR call Settle directly.
   - On submit failure (order == null or exception): ledger.Fail(account, instrument, legName).

CONSTRAINTS:
- Do NOT confuse bracket.StopInFlight with the ledger. The bracket flags are mutual exclusion between two syncs; the ledger is 'an order has been submitted and has not appeared in Account.Orders yet'.
- Reconcile suppresses Create only, never Cancel (P0-50).
- Two guards in CopierReconciler.cs are unreachable and labelled as such; do not simplify them.
- The acceptance tests (TestP331_*) already exist in RiskGuardAddOnTests.cs and are currently failing because InFlightLedger does not exist. The implementation must make them pass without breaking the existing 1248 tests.
- The InFlightLedger class must be in namespace NinjaTrader.NinjaScript.AddOns so the test file (which declares that namespace under #if TESTING) can see it.
- The class must be public (or internal) so the test methods can construct it.
tickets.context: The acceptance tests are in RiskGuardAddOnTests.cs, already added at the end of the file. They construct InFlightLedger with timeoutSeconds=2, call Register/Settle/Fail/IsInFlight/PurgeExpired/Count. Read those tests for the exact API shape expected. The Reconcile method in CopierReconciler.cs already accepts stopSubmitInFlight/targetSubmitInFlight booleans. The DecideLegActions method in TradeCopierEngine.cs (line ~2976) is the caller that feeds those booleans — currently always passing false for event-driven calls.
